mapper.sql: select f.*, v.real_name as volunteer_name, p.name as pet_name, p.cover_img as pet_cover_img, a.applicant_name as applicant_name, a.phone as phone, a.audit_time as audit_time from follow_up f left join volunteer v on f.volunteer_id = v.id left join adopt_application a on f.adopt_id = a.id left join pet p on a.pet_id = p.id
mapper.insert: insert into follow_up (adopt_id, volunteer_id, content, pet_condition, is_normal, follow_time, create_time) values (#{adoptId}, #{volunteerId}, #{content}, #{petCondition}, #{isNormal}, #{followTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where f.adopt_id = #{adoptId} order by f.create_time desc

and f.content is null
and f.content is not null
and (p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.applicant_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by f.create_time desc
